methodology: Static reachability analysis: program callers (JCL EXEC PGM=, CSD transactions, CALL/XCTL), copybook consumer counts, paragraph PERFORM/GO TO reachability within living programs

scope_reduction.note: CardDemo is a purpose-built AWS demonstration app (2022-2023). Low dead-code rate (3%) is expected vs 30-50% industry average for organic legacy systems.

evidence: No JCL job executes CBTRN01C (all other batch programs have dedicated JCL: READACCT, READCARD, READCUST, READXREF, INTCALC, POSTTRAN, TRANREPT, CREASTMT)
Zero static callers: grep of all app/ source confirms CBTRN01C appears only in its own source file
Not registered in any CSD: CARDDEMO.CSD, CRDDEMOM.CSD, CRDDEMO2.CSD all lack a transaction for this program
dead_programs.reason: Read-only transaction report prototype superseded by CBTRN02C (posting) + CBTRN03C (reporting) pipeline. Was the original report program before the full transaction pipeline was built.
dead_programs.migration_action: EXCLUDE — do not migrate. No Java equivalent needed.
dead_programs.note: All 6 copybooks used by CBTRN01C (CVTRA06Y, CVCUS01Y, CVACT03Y, CVACT02Y, CVACT01Y, CVTRA05Y) are also used by living programs. No copybook becomes dead as a result of excluding CBTRN01C.

orphan_csd_entries.risk: LIVE DEFECT — CSD transaction registered (STATUS ENABLED) but no source code exists. Entering CDV1 at terminal causes CICS PGMIDERR abend.
orphan_csd_entries.migration_action: Remove CDV1/COCRDSEC CSD entry before migration. Investigate whether source was accidentally deleted.
